from v3_revision import ROOT,dump
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from copy import deepcopy
import subprocess,json,hashlib
r=ROOT/'results/revision-20261023/round2';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();c=json.loads((ROOT/'manuscript/revision-v3/paper-content.json').read_text());old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','7f19ca0da409cd0d2e2e98507621e32c192a7a9f:manuscript/revision-v3/paper-content.json'],cwd=ROOT));check=deepcopy(c);check['sections'][0]['blocks'][1]=old['sections'][0]['blocks'][1];assert check==old
assert 'Every procedure predicts the same upper quantile' not in c['sections'][0]['blocks'][1]['html'];assert 'benchmark rather than a direct peak-quantile estimate' in c['sections'][0]['blocks'][1]['html']
tables=[b for s in c['sections'] for b in s['blocks'] if b['type']=='table'];prior=json.loads((r/'post-correction-audit/prior-table-bodies.json').read_text());assert len(tables)==37 and all(a['rows']==b['rows'] for a,b in zip(tables,prior['tables']))
h=json.loads((r/'levy-ar-correction/prior-scientific-identities.json').read_text())['prior_result_hashes'];bad=[n for n,v in h.items() if sha(ROOT/n)!=v];assert not bad
tex=(ROOT/'manuscript/revision-v3/main.tex').read_text();remaining=[ch for ch in tex if '\u0370'<=ch<='\u03ff' or '\u2070'<=ch<='\u209f' or '\u2200'<=ch<='\u22ff'];assert not remaining
v=json.loads((r/'visual-bound-estimand-g16-all-pages.json').read_text());assert v['pdf_sha256']==sha(ROOT/'manuscript/revision-v3/paper.pdf') and v['blocking_defects']==0
record=dict(actual_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),only_canonical_change='sections[0].blocks[1].html: common response/score and endpoint-derived bound benchmark',other_canonical_fields_exactly_equal_g15=True,prior_table_bodies=37,prior_scientific_files=109,prior_scientific_mismatches=bad,raw_math_codepoints_in_formal_source=remaining,current_pdf_sha256=v['pdf_sha256'],new_financial_or_Monte_Carlo_experiment=False,seven_hour_goal_finished=False)
dump(r/'post-correction-audit/bound-estimand-resolution-g16.json',record);print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
